{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''SoCalGas North-South Project''' is a cancelled natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://docs.cpuc.ca.gov/PublishedDocs/Published/G000/M165/K076/165076829.PDF|title=docs.cpuc.ca.gov|website=docs.cpuc.ca.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/project-news/20072016/cpuc-reject-socalgas-north-south-pipeline-project/|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Adelanto Compressor Station, California to Moreno Valley Pressure Limiting Station, California.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/project-news/20072016/cpuc-reject-socalgas-north-south-pipeline-project/|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Southern California Gas Co<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://docs.cpuc.ca.gov/PublishedDocs/Published/G000/M165/K076/165076829.PDF|title=docs.cpuc.ca.gov|website=docs.cpuc.ca.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''300 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''65 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/project-news/20072016/cpuc-reject-socalgas-north-south-pipeline-project/|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/project-news/20072016/cpuc-reject-socalgas-north-south-pipeline-project/|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Cancelled<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://docs.cpuc.ca.gov/PublishedDocs/Published/G000/M165/K076/165076829.PDF|title=docs.cpuc.ca.gov|website=docs.cpuc.ca.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/project-news/20072016/cpuc-reject-socalgas-north-south-pipeline-project/|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Proposal year: '''2013<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://docs.cpuc.ca.gov/PublishedDocs/Published/G000/M165/K076/165076829.PDF|title=docs.cpuc.ca.gov|website=docs.cpuc.ca.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$621,300,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.worldpipelines.com/project-news/20072016/cpuc-reject-socalgas-north-south-pipeline-project/|title=worldpipelines.com|website=worldpipelines.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
